description: Build and improve rolecards and software with 21 focused skills, plain-language explanations, user-selected guidance levels, inherited-card onboarding, prose refinement and evidence-based reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Make, improve, and understand rolecards and software.
interface.longDescription: TavernWeave 1.5.0: 21 skills share plain language and contextual terminology. Users select 新人/入门/熟练/老手 guidance, with detailed needed and bug explanations at every level. Inherited-card onboarding covers derivative work and continued updates. Existing prose, review, brainstorming, library and Soul capabilities remain available.
defaultPrompt: 我接手了这张角色卡，想沿原作继续更新；先帮我看懂原卡，再选第一次改动。
我想做一个小作品，请用大白话帮我整理想法，解释术语和推荐理由。
查看我当前的 TW 引导挡位，解释四档的区别，先不要更改设置。
